blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Union of Peoples’ Lawyers (NUPL) on Sunday criticized the remarks of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on protests against the Pax Silica initiative, noting that his administration already took measures to push for the said project. The NUPL issued this statement after Marcos last Friday said he was “perplexed” by the protests against the US-led initiative, as he stressed that “there is no deal yet.” He also said that the project does not include plans to build data centers in the country.
